note: Patches other mods make to the same code, the same way, as one of our switches. Exactly one copy may run: while the other mod's patch is active (installed, its mixin listed for this side, its option on), our switch steps aside; otherwise our switch applies and the other mod's mixin is cancelled. See bons.furious.guard.ForeignPatches. Checked against Collections Of Optimizations 4.4 (CurseForge file 9026925, sha1 d1b067885b0827c12b7eb75bc02896d270adaed8) on 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03 (1.0.28), GeckoBetterFPS 1.0.2 (1.0.28), ServerCore 1.5.2 (2026-10-04), and Collections Of Optimizations 4.6 (CurseForge file 9069255, sha1 6af9f690130f77ccff43abda949a58171f396afe) on 2026-10-09 (1.0.36).

yields.name: Collections Of Optimizations
yields.why: Both run RenderSystem.limitDisplayFPS just before Window.updateDisplay. Called twice in a row the limiter waits a second full frame interval, so with both on every frame waits twice and a frame-rate cap is halved (vsync off).

yields.name: Collections Of Optimizations
yields.why: Both @Overwrite EventFactory.invokeMethod with the same direct Method.invoke. Mixin keeps the first and logs 'Method overwrite conflict ... Skipping method' for the other; with COO's option off its copy is the original MethodHandle path.

yields.name: Collections Of Optimizations
yields.why: Both make MagnetUtil.tickMagnetism run one point-of-interest query for both magnet types. Ours @Overwrites the method; COO's two @WrapOperation(INVOKE) injectors then target a method merged at equal priority, which Mixin refuses (InvalidInjectionException, whatever require says): the game crashes with 'Ticking entity' the first time an entity's magnetism ticks (reproduced 2026-10-02 on a client and on a dedicated server). COO's mixin applies even with its option off, so ours must leave it out whenever ours applies.

yields.name: ServerCore
yields.why: ServerCore's mixin @Redirects the same call our switch @Redirects: ServerLevel.isNaturalSpawningAllowed(ChunkPos) inside ServerChunkCache.tickChunks. Mixin applies only one @Redirect of a call, so the second one fails; with ServerCore installed our switch steps aside and ServerCore keeps its own change. ServerCore's settings file is YAML, which is not read here, so the switch steps aside whenever ServerCore lists the mixin.
